slots.name: project size
slots.sentence: Trump said the planned 90,000-square-foot project, which includes a drone-launching pad and underground military complex, is necessary for national security purposes and would provide a much larger venue for state dinners.

slots.name: construction crew
slots.sentence: While a final decision on the legality of the ballroom has yet to be reached, construction will be allowed to continue following the Supreme Court ruling, as a 250-person crew works at the site 20 hours a day, seven days a week, according to court records.

slots.name: project cost
slots.sentence: The projects — which range from the estimated $400 million ballroom and a 250-foot triumphal arch to smaller-scale renovations of parks and monuments across the city — have sparked concern from preservationists, and in some cases, prompted litigation to block their progress.

slots.name: donor contract value
slots.sentence: In June, government watchdog group Public Citizen published an analysis finding that 14 of the ballroom’s 27 known corporate donors received new or increased federal contracts worth more than $50 billion within the first six months of this year.
